verse.verse_4: And taught him to express clearly.
verse.verse_5: The sun and moon revolve to a computation;
verse.verse_6: And the grasses and the trees bow (to Him) in adoration.
verse.verse_7: He raised the sky and set the Balance
verse.verse_8: So that none may err against the scales,
verse.verse_9: And observe correct measure, weigh with justice, and not cheat the balance.
verse.verse_10: He positioned the earth for all the creatures:
verse.verse_11: There are fruits of all kinds on it, and date-palms with their clusters sheathed,
verse.verse_12: Grain with husk, and fragrant grasses.
verse.verse_13: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_14: He created man of fermented clay dried tinkling hard like earthen ware,
verse.verse_15: And created jinns from the white-hot flame of fire.
verse.verse_16: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_17: Lord of the two Easts, Lord of the two Wests.
verse.verse_18: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_19: He has set two seas in motion that flow side by side together,
verse.verse_20: With an interstice between them which they cannot cross.
verse.verse_21: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_22: Out of them come pearls and coral.
verse.verse_23: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_24: His are the high-sailed vessels in deep ocean like the mountains.
verse.verse_25: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_26: All that is on the earth is passing,
verse.verse_27: But abiding is the glory of your Lord, full of majesty and beneficence.
verse.verse_28: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_29: All those there are in the heavens and the earth turn to Him with solicitation, intent on His purpose all the time.
verse.verse_30: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_31: We shall soon be free to turn to you, O weary caravans,
verse.verse_32: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_33: O society of jinns and men, cross the bounds of the heavens and the earth if you have the ability, then pass beyond them; but you cannot unless you acquire the law.
verse.verse_34: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_35: Let loose at you will be smokeless flames of fire so that you will not be able to defend yourselves.
verse.verse_36: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_37: When the sky will split asunder, and turn rosy like the dregs of annointing oil,
verse.verse_38: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_39: Neither man nor jinn will be questioned on that day about his sin.
verse.verse_40: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_41: The sinners will be recognised by their marks, and seized by the forelock and their feet.
verse.verse_42: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_43: This is Hell the sinners called a lie.
verse.verse_44: They will go round and around between it and boiling water.
verse.verse_45: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_46: But for him who lived in awe of the sublimity of his Lord, there will be two gardens --
verse.verse_47: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_49: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny? --
verse.verse_50: With two springs of water flowing through them both. --
verse.verse_51: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_52: In both of them there will be every kind of fruits in pairs. --
verse.verse_53: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_54: Reclining there on carpets lined with brocade, fruits of the garden hanging low within reach.
verse.verse_55: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_56: In them maidens with averted glances, undeflowered by man or by jinn before them, --
verse.verse_57: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_59: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny?
verse.verse_60: Should the reward of goodness be aught else but goodness? --
verse.verse_61: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_62: And besides these two other gardens --
verse.verse_63: Which of the favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_65: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_67: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_68: With fruits in them, and dates and pomegranates --
verse.verse_69: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_70: In them good and comely maidens --
verse.verse_71: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny? --
verse.verse_73: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny? --
verse.verse_74: Undeflowered by man or by jinn before them, --
verse.verse_75: How many favours of your Lord will then both of you deny? --
verse.verse_76: Reclining on green cushions and rich carpets excellent.
verse.verse_77: How many favours of your Lord will you then deny?
verse.verse_78: Blessed be the name of your Lord, full of majesty and beneficience.
